title: ERB - Endocarditis Register Bonn
summary:
The study is investigating the treatment of infective endocarditis, a dangerous heart valve disease with a high mortality rate. In particular, research is being carried out into when an operation makes sense and which surgical methods are most suitable. To this end, a medical database is being set up in which patient information is stored and analyzed. The aim is to improve the quality of treatment and gain new insights for medical research.

The data collected includes disease progression, surgical results and long-term aftercare information. The results should help to develop better treatment strategies, particularly for high-risk patients such as people with artificial heart valves or intravenous drug use.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. all patients who have undergone cardiac surgery at the Clinic for Cardiac Surgery
at the Clinic and Polyclinic for Cardiac Surgery at the University Hospital Bonn.
2. signed declaration of consent for participation and data collection (DSGVO). Inclusion of patients who are capable of giving consent for the procedure or whose consent has been given by a legal representative.
OR
3. all patients who have undergone surgery for endocarditis since 2010 at the UKB
and the other named centers since 2010. These patients can be contacted and included retrospectively.
Exclusion criteria:
No consent to participate.
